name: next-sanity-starter
description: Reusable Next.js website and Sanity Studio starter

scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir studio build
scripts.verify:typegen: pnpm typegen && git diff --exit-code -- studio/schema.json frontend/sanity.types.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir studio typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend test && node --test 'frontend/**/*.test.mjs' 'studio/**/*.test.mjs' && pnpm test:setup
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:typegen && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_BUILD=1 pnpm test:smoke
